title: Histone H3.3 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody Immunofluorescence Protocol
author: Rosie Liu
materials: Experimental Outcome The experiment successfully achieved specific and sensitive detection of endogenous Histone H3.3 in HeLa cells, validating the excellent performance of the CUSABIO Histone H3.3 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (Cat. No. CSB-RA010109A0HU) in IF applications.

Target Specificity: The strict nuclear localization of the fluorescence signal, combined with the absence of non-specific cytoplasmic staining, confirms that Histone H3.3 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (Cat. No. CSB-RA010109A0HU) specifically recognizes endogenous Histone H3.3 protein in HeLa cells, with no off-target binding.

The Histone H3.3 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (Cat. No. CSB-RA010109A0HU) exhibits exceptional performance in immunofluorescence applications, characterized by high target specificity, excellent detection sensitivity, and accurate nuclear subcellular localization. The antibody reliably detects endogenous Histone H3.3 in HeLa cells under the standardized protocol conditions, fully meeting the requirements of cell biology, epigenetic research, and related in situ protein detection studies.

steps.title: Maintain HeLa cells in culture
steps.instruction: Culture HeLa cells in complete medium at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a humidified incubator.

steps.title: Harvest cells in log phase
steps.instruction: Select HeLa cells in logarithmic growth phase with viability > 90 %; detach using trypsinization (or equivalent); collect suspension in a sterile 15 mL centrifuge tube; centrifuge at 1000 rpm (~200 × g) for 5 min at room temperature; aspirate and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash harvested cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL pre‑warmed complete medium, centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 5 min; repeat the wash two additional times (total three washes) to remove residual trypsin and debris.

steps.title: Seed cells into 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Resuspend washed cells in fresh complete medium at a density that will give 50–60 % confluence after overnight culture; dispense into a 96‑well plate ensuring uniform single‑cell dispersion; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare 1× PBS
steps.instruction: Dilute the autoclaved 10× PBS (80 g NaCl, 2 g KCl, 14.4 g Na₂HPO₄, 2.4 g KH₂PO₄ per litre, pH 7.4) with sterile water to 1×; keep at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % formaldehyde fixative
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, dilute methanol‑free 16 % formaldehyde stock with 1× PBS to a final concentration of 4 % (v/v); prepare fresh immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare 0.2 % Triton X‑100 solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.2 mL Triton X‑100 in 99.8 mL 1× PBS; mix until completely dissolved; store at 4 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % goat serum block
steps.instruction: Dilute normal goat serum with 1× PBS to 10 % (v/v); aliquot and store at –20 °C; thaw on ice before use.

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Dilute Histone H3.3 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (CSB‑RA010109A0HU) 1:60 in 1× PBS; make enough volume to fully cover each well.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Dilute Alexa Fluor 488‑conjugated AffiniPure Goat Anti‑Rabbit IgG (H+L) 1:200–1:500 in 1× PBS; keep protected from light and use immediately.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with 1× PBS; add 4 % formaldehyde and incubate 10–15 min at room temperature; wash three times with PBS; add 0.2 % Triton X‑100 and incubate 20 min at room temperature; wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add 10 % normal goat serum blocking buffer to each well and incubate 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Cover cells with the 1:60 primary antibody solution; incubate overnight (~16 h) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with 1× PBS.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Cover cells with the secondary antibody solution (1:200–1:500); incubate 1 h at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with 1× PBS.

steps.title: Additional PBS washes
steps.instruction: Perform an additional three washes with 1× PBS.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Prepare DAPI working solution (1–5 µg/mL in PBS from a 1 mg/mL stock); add to cells and incubate for a short, appropriate time (avoid over‑staining).

steps.title: Detect fluorescence
steps.instruction: Keep the stained plate protected from light and acquire fluorescence images as soon as possible.
